$description: Family → embedded woff2 faces and licence, read by scripts/assemble.py, which embeds the faces of every family a style names. Faces are the latin subsets of the variable fonts as served by Google Fonts; licence texts are the SIL OFL 1.1 files from github.com/google/fonts (ofl/newsreader/OFL.txt, ofl/inter/OFL.txt), fetched 23 Nov 2026. Neither declares a Reserved Font Name.
